SAFETY DATA SHEET
Product name: Wallbright Interior Matt White 10L
Wallbright Paints Pty Ltd (fictional example)
Revision date: March 2022

SECTION 1: Identification
Recommended use: Interior water-based wall paint.
Emergency telephone number: 1800 555 0177

SECTION 2: Hazards identification
Not classified as a hazardous substance or mixture according to the Globally Harmonised System (GHS).
Not classified as hazardous according to the model WHS Regulations. No signal word. No hazard statements.

SECTION 3: Composition
Water 7732-18-5 40-60 %
Titanium dioxide 13463-67-7 10-20 %

SECTION 7: Handling and storage
Store between 5 and 30 C. Keep containers closed.

SECTION 8: Exposure controls
General ventilation is adequate. Gloves recommended for prolonged contact.

SECTION 9: Physical and chemical properties
Appearance: white liquid.

SECTION 14: Transport information
Not classified as dangerous goods. Not regulated for transport.
